in_hebrew.name: Faus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Faus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word ‘pistos’, meaning ‘faithful’ or ‘trustworthy’. In the New Testament, the name ‘Faustus’ appears in the Book of Acts, referring to a Roman officer who became a Christian after witnessing Paul’s miraculous escape from prison.
